capabilities.justification: Enumerates direct child plugin directories in deterministic precedence order.

capabilities.target: plugin.toml, selected runtime entry, and declared config schema beneath an explicit plugin root
capabilities.justification: Parses and authenticates manifests, computes entry-bound identities, and loads declared metadata after realpath containment checks.

capabilities.target: a fresh private plugin working directory under the system temporary directory
capabilities.justification: Creates one empty cwd per isolated plugin process so the process cannot infer the project layout from its working directory.

capabilities.target: the host-created private plugin working directory
capabilities.justification: Removes only the exact temporary directory created for the plugin session after exit or failure.

capabilities.target: plugin processes returned by the caller-supplied isolation launcher
capabilities.justification: Escalates cancellation and disposal through TERM/KILL so crashed or uncooperative plugins cannot outlive the host.

justification: Discovery is filesystem-bound and execution is delegated to an injected launcher that must attest sandbox isolation. The host never falls back to ambient process spawning, shell, environment, or network access.
